claims.statement: Tom Allen lost to Charley Gallagher in a brief contest on Tuesday, 23 February 1869, being knocked out of time by a blow.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, recovered from the prostrating blow that knocked him out of time, was there.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he would re-meet Charley Gallagher in the ring within a week to a month for $1,000 to $5,000, but was no bar-room fighter.

claims.statement: Jack Looney offered $1,500 to $1,200 that Tom Allen could whip Charley Gallagher in another tussle.
claims.excerpt: could be heard to offer $1,500 to $1,200 that Allen re can whip Gallagher in another tussle.

claims.statement: A rematch between Tom Allen and Charley Gallagher was expected once calm was restored.
